issue_title: [Security] Broad exception catch may hide unexpected errors
approach: Add DEBUG-level traceback logging to the exception handler in cli.py
changes_summary: Added logging module import and logger initialization to cli.py
Added traceback module import to cli.py
Added logger.debug() call to log full traceback when exceptions occur
Created new test file test_issue_6658_exception_traceback_logging.py with 4 tests
risks: Minimal - only adds debug logging, does not change user-facing behavior
Traceback is only visible when logging is configured at DEBUG level
limitations: Does not implement --debug flag as suggested in issue (minimal fix approach)
Does not separate exception types (ValueError, OSError) - keeps unified handler
